markRegion.problem: OMP's guarded native apply reports one whole-file edit even for a small change, so the mark and the lens originally spanned the file (logged line=0 while the model changed line 1)
markRegion.fix: the mark is derived from the text the apply actually produced: changedLineSpan(applyEdits(textBefore, edits), textBefore) in apps/macos/src/agent-edit-marks.ts, falling back to the edit geometry when the produced text is unchanged
markRegion.verifiedInTheRealApp: rebuilt and re-ran on the packaged app; Caret.log then read 'agent edit lenses offered path=src/greet.ts decisions=2 line=1', the changed line
markRegion.unit: agent-edit-marks.test.ts covers applyEdits (single/multiple edits), a whole-file edit narrowing to the changed line, an inserted line, equal texts, and the fallback

codeLensStaleness.found: on the packaged app, after clicking Keep: the editor-title buttons withdrew and the file was saved, but the in-editor CodeLens still offered both decisions while provideCodeLenses would have returned [] - the engine was showing a cached result
codeLensStaleness.mechanism: a CodeLensProvider is re-queried on document change or on onDidChangeCodeLenses; the lenses depend on extension state, and the provider never fired that event
codeLensStaleness.severity: same honesty class as the earlier dead caretDock.focus id: a control that looks live but is not, and would refuse on invoke
codeLensStaleness.fix: #agentEditLensesChanged (vscode.EventEmitter) is fired from refreshAgentEditMarks(), which already runs on every pending-state change (record, keep, take back, save, close, visible-editor change); the provider returns onDidChangeCodeLenses: that event, and the emitter is disposed with the provider
codeLensStaleness.verifiedInTheRealApp: after a rebuild, clicking Keep reported 'kept the edit', the title buttons withdrew, and the lens was gone (LENS still present: false, which was true before the fix)
codeLensStaleness.unitAndBehavioral: the workbench suite asserts the provider exposes the event, fires once on record and again on keep, and returns no lenses afterwards

markPixels.verified: the decoration is painted on the changed line with the theme's own highlight colour
markPixels.method: two screenshot pairs of the packaged app, read with a stdlib-only PNG pixel probe (scripts/png-pixel-probe.py); no vision model and no imaging library
markPixels.pairA: clearing the mark with Keep also saves, so the diff mixes in save-induced chrome on the same rows; the largest editor-column band starts at the git gutter. Not isolable on its own.
markPixels.pairB: clearing the mark with Reload Window keeps the unsaved buffer (still unsaved: true) while the extension state is fresh (mark after reload: false), so the text is identical and only Caret's rendering is gone. It also showed the CodeLens occupies editor layout: rows 380..423 are identical, but the last bright row is y=491 with the mark and y=459 without, about one CodeLens row.
markPixels.decisiveColourCheck: the decoration paints ThemeColor editor.wordHighlightStrongBackground (#27678280 over editor.background #121314 = about rgb(29, 61, 75)). In the editor text column (x 1032..2531, y 430..500) the mark-on capture holds rgb(38, 61, 74) with 18217 px (18289 within +/-2) while the mark-off capture holds 0. No other Caret surface paints that colour, and selection/find colours composite to rgb(36,92,115) / rgb(30,66,82), different in green and blue.
markPixels.conclusion: counted 18217 pixels of the decoration's own composited theme colour only while the mark was pending and none when it was not, so the mark renders on the changed line in the packaged app.

staleTakeBackRefusal.rule: take-back restores the exact pre-edit text, which is only honest while the buffer still holds the version Caret produced
staleTakeBackRefusal.inTheRealApp: after the agent edit landed, the operator typed one character into the editor and then clicked Take Back the Caret Edit: 'stale refusal shown: true' and 'took back: false', so the refusal fired and no take-back message or buffer rewrite appeared
staleTakeBackRefusal.disk: src/greet.ts still held the pre-edit text afterwards, so the refused action wrote nothing
staleTakeBackRefusal.closes: the last agent-edit refusal path that had only been covered by unit and behavioral tests
